worldcombat.skill.direclaw.summary: One deep claw rakes three gashes into the target at once, then presses one of poison, paralysis or sleep into the cut. It aims at a weak point, so it lands criticals more often than ordinary moves. Deep Wound trades damage for a heavier, longer mark; the Favour setting picks which mark you want.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.use.0: A close deep claw that presses one of three marks into the wound
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.use.1: Pick sleep for a high-value target
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.use.2: Aim at a weak point for a heavier critical
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.description.0: One deep claw deals about %1$s damage; on a hit it has about a %2$s chance to press one of poison/paralysis/sleep into the wound for about %3$s. The target's Defence, type matchup and this move's own critical settle at impact, and type or ability immunity to that status still applies.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.description.1: Claw reach about %1$s blocks, critical chance about %2$s (higher than ordinary moves).
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.deep.on: Deep Wound: ailment chance +0.15, ailment duration x1.25, critical chance +0.06, at the cost of claw power x0.88, wind-up +1 tick and cooldown x1.12.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.deep.off: Swift Rake (default): claw power x1.08, wind-up -1 tick and cooldown x0.95, with the mark and critical back at baseline.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.favor.random: Favour = Random (default): on a hit, one of poison, paralysis or sleep is chosen with equal odds.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.favor.poison: Favour = Poison: the wound is marked with poison, good for grinding down a tanky target.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.favor.paralys: Favour = Paralysis: the wound is marked with paralysis, making a fast target fumble and slowing it.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.favor.sleep: Favour = Sleep: the wound is marked with sleep, taking a dangerous target out of the fight for a moment.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.timing: Range %1$s, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.growth.0: From level %1$s the claw power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.growth.1: From level %1$s the claw power rises to %2$s, the ailment chance to %3$s and the critical chance to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.preference.de: On: ailment chance +0.15, ailment duration x1.25 and critical chance +0.06, but claw power x0.88, wind-up +1 tick and cooldown x1.12. Off: swift rake, claw power x1.08, wind-up -1 tick and cooldown x0.95, with the mark and critical at baseline.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.preference.fa: Pick which of the three marks to press into the wound (Random means equal odds). Poison for a tanky target, paralysis for a fast one, sleep for a dangerous one.
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of clawing; larger values let it pounce from further away.
When on, a target carrying no major status ranks higher, so the one-of-three mark is not wasted on someone already afflicted.
world_combat.move.direclaw.text.paralysi: Numbing sparks run through the wound
world_combat.move.direclaw.text.resist: The mark did not take hold
worldcombat.skill.direclaw.description.a: Each hit presses in at most one mark: poison drains health over time; paralysis halves movement speed and gives each action a 25% chance to fail; sleep stops both acting and moving until the target takes damage.
